description: This file is an HTML document implementing a web-based database viewer interface. It includes structure, style, and client-side scripting to list databases, tables, and display data from a PostgreSQL database, making it primarily a frontend source file.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading databases and resetting UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables from a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and inserts an HTML table based on data records.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates table cell HTML, handling different data types including objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
